name: Sarvajan Pension Yojana
department: Department of Social Security & Welfare, Jharkhand
description: Universal pension scheme providing monthly financial assistance to vulnerable citizens of Jharkhand, including the elderly, widows, and disabled persons.

not_receiving_other_pension.description: Must not be receiving pension from any other government scheme

benefits.description: ₹1,000 per month transferred directly to beneficiary's bank account (DBT).

documents_required.name: Caste Certificate
documents_required.condition: If applying under SC/ST for early age eligibility

offline_steps: Collect the form from your Block/Circle office or Panchayat
Fill in personal and bank details and attach required documents
Submit to Block Development Officer (BDO) or Circle Officer (CO)

name: Abua Awas Yojana
description: Jharkhand state housing scheme providing financial assistance to build 3-room pucca houses for homeless and kutcha-house-dwelling families.

benefits.description: ₹2 Lakh in 4 installments for construction of a 3-room pucca house.

offline_steps: Applications collected at Gram Sabha or 'Aapki Yojana Aapki Sarkar' outreach camps
Verification done by Block Development Officer
Funds released in 4 installments upon construction milestones

name: Pradhan Mantri Awaas Yojana – Gramin (PMAY-G)
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
description: Central government scheme to provide pucca houses with basic amenities to houseless families and those living in kutcha/dilapidated houses in rural areas.

bpl_card.description: BPL / SECC list families get priority

benefits.description: ₹1.30 Lakh for plain areas, ₹1.50 Lakh for hilly/NE states; plus 90 days MGNREGA unskilled wage support.

offline_steps: Beneficiaries are selected from SECC 2011 data by Gram Sabha
Verification done at Block office and District office
Funds released via PFMS directly to bank account

name: Jharkhand Krishi Rin Mafi Yojana
description: Provides relief to small and marginal KCC loan holders by waiving agricultural loans up to ₹2 Lakh.

benefits.description: Waiver of outstanding KCC agricultural loan up to ₹2,00,000 per farmer.

offline_steps: Beneficiaries identified by banks from SECC data
e-KYC at Pragya Kendra (CSC) for Rs. 1 nominal fee

name: PM Kisan Samman Nidhi Yojana
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of India
description: Central government income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year in three installments to small and marginal farmer families.

benefits.description: ₹6,000 per year (₹2,000 every 4 months) directly via DBT to farmer's bank account.

offline_steps: Register through local Patwari / Revenue officer or CSC

name: Mukhyamantri Krishi Ashirwad Yojana (MMKAY)
description: Jharkhand state scheme providing input subsidy to small and marginal farmers at the beginning of Kharif season for seeds, fertilizers, and farm machinery.

benefits.description: ₹5,000 per acre per year, maximum ₹25,000 per family for up to 5 acres.

offline_steps: Register at nearest Pragya Kendra (CSC) or Block Agriculture Office
Funds credited directly to bank account before Kharif season

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare, Government of India
description: Crop insurance scheme providing financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage due to unforeseen events like natural calamities, pests, and diseases.

benefits.description: Farmer pays only 2% premium for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial crops. Government pays the rest. Full sum insured paid on total crop loss.

offline_steps: Enroll through your bank (mandatory for loan-taking farmers)
Non-loan farmers can enroll online at pmfby.gov.in or through CSC

name: Savitribai Phule Kishori Samriddhi Yojana
department: Department of Women and Child Development, Jharkhand
description: Financial assistance scheme to promote girls' education, prevent child marriage, and empower adolescent girls in Jharkhand through milestone-based scholarships.

benefits.description: Class 8/9: ₹2,500; Class 10/11/12: ₹5,000; On turning 18-19 (unmarried): one-time ₹20,000. Total potential: ₹40,000.

offline_steps: Forms available at Anganwadi centres or the school
Submit completed form with documents to school headmaster or Anganwadi Sevika

name: Mukhyamantri Mahila Kisan Sashaktikaran (MMKSY)
description: Empowers rural women farmers through SHG (Self Help Group) network, providing agriculture inputs, training, and market linkage support.

shg_member.description: Priority if member of Sakhi Mandal / SHG

benefits.description: Agriculture inputs, Seeds + fertilizers, free training; potential ₹50,000 grant for farm development through JSLPS.

offline_steps: Contact your local Sakhi Mandal or JSLPS block coordinator
Apply through the Jeevika or JSLPS program officer at block level

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
department: Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India
description: Maternity benefit scheme providing cash incentive for partial wage compensation during pregnancy and nursing, and encouraging women to follow best practices.

benefits.description: ₹5,000 in 3 installments: ₹1,000 on early ANC registration, ₹2,000 after 6-month ANC check, ₹2,000 after child birth registration and first vaccination.

offline_steps: Submit form with documents to AWC Sevika / Health Sub-centre

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Yojana (SSY)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Savings scheme for the girl child ensuring financial security. Parents/guardians can open an account in the name of a girl child below 10 years.

benefits.description: Current interest rate 8.2% p.a. Minimum ₹250/yr deposit. Maturity at 21 years; partial withdrawal at 18 for education/marriage.

offline_steps: Visit any Post Office or authorized bank branch (SBI, PNB, etc.)
Deposit minimum ₹250 to activate the account

name: Mukhyamantri Rojgar Srijan Yojana (CMEGP)
description: Provides subsidized bank loans to youth from marginalized communities to start their own businesses / micro enterprises in Jharkhand.

benefits.description: Loan up to ₹25 Lakh with 40% subsidy (max ₹5 lakh). No guarantor for loans up to ₹50,000.

offline_steps: Submit application at District Welfare Office / ITDA / Minority Finance Corporation
Bank reviews and sanctions the loan with subsidy

name: Mahatma Gandhi NREGA (MGNREGS)
name_hindi: महात्मा गांधी राष्ट्रीय ग्रामीण रोजगार गारंटी योजना
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
description: Legal guarantee of 100 days of unskilled manual wage employment per year to rural households whose adult members volunteer to do such work.

benefits.description: ₹257/day wage (Jharkhand rate) for 100 days guaranteed work. Women get 1/3 reservation.

offline_steps: Get/verify your Job Card from Gram Panchayat
Submit written application for work at Gram Panchayat office
Work must be provided within 15 days of application

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
department: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
description: Supports traditional artisans and craftspeople (18 trades) with free skill training, toolkits worth ₹15,000, and collateral-free loans at concessional rates.

benefits.description: ₹15,000 toolkit; Skill training with ₹500/day stipend; Collateral-free loan: ₹1 Lakh (Tranche 1), ₹2 Lakh (Tranche 2) at 5% subsidized interest.

offline_steps: Register at nearest CSC (Pragya Kendra) with Aadhaar and mobile
Complete skill training set by NSDC
Apply for toolkit grant and loan after training

name: Pre-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST Students
name_hindi: अनुसूचित जाति/जनजाति छात्रों के लिए प्री-मेट्रिक छात्रवृत्ति
department: Department of Welfare, Jharkhand / Ministry of Social Justice
description: Scholarship to SC/ST students studying in Classes 9 and 10 to prevent dropout and encourage continuation of education.

benefits.description: ₹3,500/year for day scholars; ₹7,000/year for hostel students. In addition, book grants and maintenance allowance.

offline_steps: Apply online on National Scholarship Portal (NSP)
Amount disbursed directly to student's account

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC
department: Ministry of Social Justice / Tribal Affairs, Government of India
description: Scholarship for SC/ST/OBC students studying at post-matriculation or post-secondary stage to enable them to complete their education.

benefits.description: Maintenance allowance + compulsory fees covered. For SC: family income below ₹2.5 lakh; For ST: ₹2.5 lakh; For OBC: ₹1 lakh.

offline_steps: Apply via National Scholarship Portal (NSP) before the deadline

name: Mukhyamantri Medha Chatravriti Yojana
department: Department of School Education & Literacy, Jharkhand
description: Merit-based scholarship for meritorious students of Class 9 studying in government schools of Jharkhand who passed Class 8 with top scores.

benefits.description: ₹12,000/year for students who qualify the state-level merit exam.

offline_steps: Selected through a state-level competitive exam (MMCY Exam)
Scholarship paid directly to student's account

name: Ayushman Bharat – Jan Arogya Yojana (AB-PMJAY)
name_hindi: आयुष्मान भारत – प्रधानमंत्री जन आरोग्य योजना
department: National Health Authority, Government of India
description: World's largest health insurance scheme providing coverage of ₹5 Lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary hospitalization at empanelled hospitals.

bpl_card.description: BPL/SECC 2011 listed families are primary beneficiaries

benefits.description: ₹5 Lakh cashless health coverage per family per year at empanelled government and private hospitals. Covers 1,929+ procedures.

offline_steps: Check eligibility at Ayushman Mitra kiosk at any empanelled hospital
Or check online at beneficiary.nha.gov.in with Aadhaar / Ration Card
No enrollment needed — auto-enrolled if in SECC 2011 list

name: PM Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana (PMJJBY)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Renewable life insurance scheme offering ₹2 Lakh term cover for death due to any cause at just ₹436 per year premium.

bank_account.description: Must have savings bank account linked to Aadhaar

benefits.description: ₹2,00,000 life cover for death due to any cause. Premium: ₹436/year (auto-deducted from bank account).

offline_steps: Fill PMJJBY enrollment form at your bank branch
Or enroll through net banking / mobile banking of your bank

name: PM Suraksha Bima Yojana (PMSBY)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Accident insurance scheme providing coverage for accidental death and disability at a premium of just ₹20/year.

benefits.description: ₹2,00,000 for accidental death or total disability; ₹1,00,000 for partial disability. Premium: ₹20/year.

offline_steps: Fill PMSBY enrollment form at your bank branch
Or enroll through net banking / mobile banking

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC)
department: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare / NABARD
description: Credit card for farmers providing flexible revolving credit for agricultural inputs, post-harvest expenses, and allied activities at subsidized interest rates.

benefits.description: Credit limit up to ₹3 Lakh at 7% interest (4% effective with interest subvention for timely repayment). Includes crop + personal accident insurance.

offline_steps: Apply at your nearest cooperative bank, SBI, or regional rural bank
PM Kisan beneficiaries can apply online via PM Kisan portal

name: Mukhyamantri Divyang Pension Yojana
description: Monthly pension for persons with disabilities in Jharkhand who have 40% or more disability and are below 60 years of age.

benefits.description: ₹1,000 per month. Persons with 80%+ disability get ₹1,500/month.

offline_steps: Submit application at Block office or Circle office
Attach disability certificate from authorized medical authority
Verified by district social welfare officer

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana – Urban (PMAY-U)
department: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs, Government of India
description: Provides affordable housing to urban poor including slum dwellers, EWS, LIG, and MIG categories through Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).

women_head.description: EWS/LIG houses must be in name of woman or co-ownership

bpl_card.description: BPL families get in-situ slum redevelopment priority

benefits.description: EWS/LIG: Subsidy of 6.5% on loan up to ₹6L (max ₹2.67L subsidy). MIG-I: 4% on ₹9L. MIG-II: 3% on ₹12L.

documents_required.name: Aadhaar Card of all adult family members
Affidavit of no pucca house ownership in India

offline_steps: Apply online at pmaymis.gov.in or at city/municipal office
For CLSS: apply through Housing Finance Companies or banks
For slum redevelopment: apply through Urban Local Body (Municipality)

name: Mukhyamantri Sukhad Rahat Yojana (Widow Relief)
description: Relief assistance to drought-affected farm families in Jharkhand providing immediate income support for food and agricultural recovery.

benefits.description: ₹3,500 immediate relief per affected farm family via DBT during declared drought periods.

offline_steps: Registration done automatically by government based on Gram Sabha surveys
Verify your name in the beneficiary list at block/panchayat office
Amount directly transferred to bank account

name: Jharkhand Rajya Fasal Rahat Yojana
description: Crop relief scheme providing compensation to farmers for crop loss due to natural calamities like drought, floods, hailstorms. Not insurance — no premium required.

benefits.description: ₹3,000/acre for 30-50% loss; ₹4,000/acre for >50% loss. Max 5 acres = ₹20,000.

offline_steps: Submit crop damage claim with land records

name: Jharkhand Millet Mission (Madua Kranti)
description: 5-year mission promoting Ragi (Madua) and Gondli cultivation for food security and better farmer income through subsidies and training.

benefits.description: Up to ₹15,000 subsidy for millet cultivation on 10 decimals to 5 acres.

offline_steps: Apply through CSC or Krishi Bhawan

name: Mukhyamantri Pashudhan Vikas Yojana
description: Subsidies for cattle, goat, poultry and pig rearing to boost rural income. 50-90% subsidy based on category.

benefits.description: 50-90% subsidy on livestock purchase, shed construction, and equipment. SC/ST get up to 90%.

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
department: Ministry of Agriculture, Government of India
description: Free soil testing and health card for farmers with crop-wise recommendations on nutrients and fertilizers.

benefits.description: Free soil health card with nutrient status and fertilizer recommendations. Issued every 2 years.

offline_steps: Or apply online for soil sample collection

name: PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana (PMKSY)
department: Ministry of Agriculture, Government of India
description: Provides subsidized drip and sprinkler irrigation systems to farmers for water conservation and better yield.

benefits.description: 55% subsidy for small/marginal farmers, 45% for others on micro-irrigation (drip/sprinkler).

offline_steps: Or register online on PMKSY portal

name: Namo Drone Didi Scheme
department: Ministry of Agriculture, Government of India
description: Provides drones to women SHGs for agricultural use — spraying pesticides, crop monitoring. Includes training and subsidy.

benefits.description: 80% subsidy on drone cost (~₹8 lakh). Free pilot training. Earning potential ₹1 lakh+/year.

offline_steps: Selected SHGs receive drone and training

name: Mukhyamantri Maiyan Samman Yojana
department: Dept of Women, Child Development & Social Security, Jharkhand
description: Flagship scheme providing ₹2,500/month to women aged 21-50 for financial independence. Direct bank transfer.

benefits.description: ₹2,500 per month (₹30,000/year) via DBT. Must have Jharkhand ration card.

offline_steps: Register online or through Panchayat Sevak

name: Mukhyamantri Kanya Vivah Yojana
description: Financial assistance of ₹30,000 for marriage of girls from BPL families to prevent child marriage and support family.

benefits.description: ₹30,000 one-time grant for marriage expenses. Bride must be 18+.

name: Ladli Laxmi Yojana
department: Dept of Women & Child Development, Jharkhand
description: Long-term financial security scheme for girls providing ₹1,18,000 in stages from birth to age 21.

benefits.description: ₹6,000/year for 5 years + ₹6,000 at Class 6 + ₹6,000 at Class 9 + ₹1,00,000 at age 21.

offline_steps: Register at Anganwadi Centre within 1 year of birth
Submit birth certificate and parent documents

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)
department: Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, Government of India
description: Free LPG connections to women from BPL/deprived households for clean cooking fuel, replacing wood/coal chulhas.

benefits.description: Free LPG connection (deposit-free). Includes free first refill and stove for eligible households.

offline_steps: Apply at nearest LPG distributor with Aadhaar and BPL proof

name: One Stop Centre (Sakhi Centre)
department: Ministry of Women & Child Development, Government of India
description: 24/7 support centres for women affected by violence — provides medical, legal, police, and shelter assistance.

benefits.description: Free medical aid, legal counselling, police assistance, psycho-social support, and temporary shelter.

offline_steps: Visit nearest Sakhi Centre (One Stop Centre)

name: Phulwari (Palash) Scheme
department: Dept of Women & Child Development, Jharkhand
description: Community-based nutrition and childcare centres for children (6 months to 3 years) and lactating mothers in tribal areas.

benefits.description: Free hot cooked meals for children and mothers, health checkups, nutrition counselling at Phulwari centres.

name: Guruji Student Credit Card Scheme
department: Dept of Higher & Technical Education, Jharkhand
description: Collateral-free education loan up to ₹15 lakh at 4% interest for Jharkhand students to pursue professional courses.

benefits.description: Loan up to ₹15 lakh at 4% interest. No collateral. 15-year repayment. No processing fees.

offline_steps: Submit documents at designated bank branch

name: e-Kalyan Scholarship (SC/ST/BC)
description: State scholarship portal for SC/ST/BC students pursuing post-matric education. Covers tuition fees and maintenance.

benefits.description: Tuition fees + maintenance allowance. Amount varies by course level (₹5,000-₹15,000/year).

name: CM Education Promotion Scheme
description: Free coaching for competitive exams + ₹2,500/month accommodation allowance for students from weaker sections.

benefits.description: Free coaching + ₹2,500/month for accommodation = ₹30,000/year support.

offline_steps: Apply through school principal or district education office
Selection based on merit and family income

name: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda Overseas Scholarship
name_hindi: मरांग गोमके जयपाल सिंह मुंडा विदेश छात्रवृत्ति
description: Full scholarship for SC/ST/Minority students to study at top universities in UK. Covers tuition, living, travel.

benefits.description: Full scholarship: tuition fees + living expenses + travel for Masters/PhD at QS Top 200 universities.

documents_required.name: Admission letter from QS Top 200 university

name: National Means-cum-Merit Scholarship (NMMSS)
department: Ministry of Education, Government of India
description: Merit scholarship for Class 9-12 students from economically weaker sections studying in government schools.

benefits.description: ₹12,000/year (₹1,000/month) for Class 9-12. Selected through state-level exam.

name: PM YASASVI Scholarship
department: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment, Government of India
description: Scholarship for OBC/EBC/DNT students in Class 9-12 at top private/government schools. Vibrant India initiative.

benefits.description: Class 9-10: ₹75,000/year; Class 11-12: ₹1,25,000/year for top school students.

offline_steps: Apply online on NTA YASASVI portal

name: Begum Hazrat Mahal Scholarship
department: Maulana Azad Education Foundation, Government of India
description: Scholarship for meritorious minority girls studying in Class 9-12 from families below poverty line.

benefits.description: Class 9-10: ₹5,000/year; Class 11-12: ₹6,000/year for minority girls.

name: PM POSHAN (Mid-Day Meal) Scheme
department: Ministry of Education, Government of India
description: Free hot cooked lunch to all children in government and aided schools (Class 1-8) to improve nutrition and attendance.

benefits.description: Free nutritious lunch daily. 450-700 calories per meal. Covers all govt school students Class 1-8.

offline_steps: Automatically available at all government/aided schools

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Collateral-free micro-loans for small businesses. Shishu (₹50K), Kishore (₹5L), Tarun (₹10L), Tarun Plus (₹20L).

benefits.description: Shishu: up to ₹50,000; Kishore: ₹50K-5L; Tarun: ₹5-10L; Tarun Plus: up to ₹20L. No collateral.

name: Stand Up India Scheme
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Bank loans between ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for SC/ST/Women entrepreneurs starting greenfield businesses.

benefits.description: Loan ₹10 lakh to ₹1 crore for new manufacturing/services/trading enterprise. Repayment up to 7 years.

offline_steps: Apply on Stand Up India portal
Each bank branch must give 1 loan to SC/ST, 1 to woman

name: PM SVANidhi (Street Vendor)
department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, Government of India
description: Micro-credit for street vendors — ₹10,000 first loan, ₹20,000 second, ₹50,000 third. Subsidized interest.

benefits.description: 1st loan: ₹10,000; 2nd: ₹20,000; 3rd: ₹50,000. 7% interest subsidy + cashback on digital payments.

offline_steps: Apply online through PM SVANidhi portal

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
description: Free skill training program for rural youth aged 15-35 with guaranteed job placement after training.

benefits.description: Free skill training (3-12 months) + hostel + food + stipend + guaranteed placement with min ₹6,000/month salary.

offline_steps: Register at Block office or JSLPS office
Select skill course and training centre

name: PM Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
department: Ministry of MSME, Government of India
description: Subsidy-linked loan scheme for setting up new micro-enterprises. 15-35% subsidy on project cost.

benefits.description: Manufacturing: up to ₹50L, Service: up to ₹20L. General: 15-25% subsidy; SC/ST/Women: 25-35% subsidy.

name: Mukhyamantri Protsahan Yojana
description: Financial incentive of ₹5,000 to unemployed youth who complete recognized skill training programs.

benefits.description: ₹5,000 one-time incentive after completing government-recognized short-term skill training.

name: Startup India Scheme
department: DPIIT, Ministry of Commerce, Government of India
description: Recognition and tax benefits for startups. 3-year tax holiday, self-certification, fast-track patent filing.

benefits.description: 3-year income tax exemption; Seed Fund up to ₹20 lakh; Self-certification for 6 labour & 3 environment laws.

name: Jharkhand State Swarojgar Yojana
description: State self-employment scheme providing subsidized loans for youth to start small businesses in Jharkhand.

benefits.description: Loan up to ₹5 lakh with 25-40% subsidy. Priority to trained youth.

offline_steps: Bank sanctions loan with state subsidy

name: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
department: PFRDA / Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Guaranteed pension of ₹1,000-₹5,000/month after age 60 for unorganized sector workers. Government co-contributes.

benefits.description: Pension ₹1,000-₹5,000/month after 60 based on contribution. Spouse continues pension after death.

offline_steps: Open APY account at any bank

name: PM Garib Kalyan Anna Yojana (Free Ration)
department: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
description: Free 5 kg rice/wheat per person per month to 80 crore beneficiaries under National Food Security Act. Extended till Dec 2028.

bpl_card.description: Must be NFSA/AAY/PHH ration card holder

benefits.description: 5 kg free food grains (rice/wheat) per person per month. AAY families get 35 kg/month per household.

offline_steps: Visit your designated Fair Price Shop (FPS)

name: Mukhyamantri Sahay Yojana
description: Funeral/death assistance of ₹25,000 to families of registered unorganized workers on death of the worker.

benefits.description: ₹25,000 one-time death/funeral assistance to nominee. Worker must have been registered on e-Shram.

offline_steps: Nominee applies at District Labour Office
Submit death certificate and e-Shram card

name: Pradhan Mantri Jan Dhan Yojana (PMJDY)
department: Ministry of Finance, Government of India
description: Zero-balance bank account for all Indians with free RuPay debit card, ₹2 lakh accident insurance, and ₹30,000 life cover.

benefits.description: Zero-balance account + free RuPay card + ₹2L accident insurance + ₹30,000 life cover + overdraft up to ₹10,000.

offline_steps: Visit any bank branch or Banking Correspondent
Open Jan Dhan account with Aadhaar

name: e-Shram Card (NDUW)
department: Ministry of Labour, Government of India
description: Universal registration for unorganized workers with ₹2 lakh accident insurance and access to welfare schemes.

benefits.description: Free ₹2 lakh accidental death/disability insurance under PMSBY. Gateway to all labour welfare schemes.

offline_steps: Or register at nearest CSC for free

name: Jharkhand Ration Card (NFSA)
department: Dept of Food & Public Distribution, Jharkhand
description: Ration card for subsidized and free food grains under NFSA. Categories: AAY, PHH, Non-Priority.

benefits.description: AAY: 35 kg/month at ₹1-3/kg. PHH: 5 kg/person/month free (under PMGKAY).

offline_steps: Or apply at Block Supply Officer (BSO) office

name: Jharkhand Accident Relief Scheme
description: Financial assistance to road accident victims — ₹50,000 for injury, ₹2 lakh for death.

benefits.description: ₹50,000 for serious injury; ₹2,00,000 for accidental death. Covers all road accident victims in Jharkhand.

offline_steps: File FIR at nearest police station
Apply at District Transport Office with medical/death certificate

name: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
department: Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India
description: ₹20,000 lump sum to BPL family on death of the primary breadwinner (18-60 years).

benefits.description: ₹20,000 lump sum to surviving family members within 45 days of breadwinner's death.

offline_steps: Submit death certificate and BPL proof

name: SVAMITVA Yojana (Property Cards)
department: Ministry of Panchayati Raj, Government of India
description: Drone survey-based property cards for rural residential land owners. Enables loans against property.

benefits.description: Free digital property card for rural residential land. Enables bank loans against property.

offline_steps: Drone survey conducted by Survey of India
Property cards distributed at Gram Sabha

name: Jharkhand Shahri Awas Yojana
description: Affordable housing for urban poor in Jharkhand's municipal areas with government subsidy.

benefits.description: ₹1.5-2.5 lakh subsidy for construction/purchase of affordable house in urban areas.

documents_required.name: Affidavit of no pucca house ownership

offline_steps: Apply at Municipal Corporation/Nagar Palika office

name: JharSewa (e-District Services)
description: One-stop portal for 50+ government certificates and services — caste, income, domicile, birth/death certificates.

benefits.description: Online application for caste, income, domicile, birth, death, marriage, residential certificates. Nominal fee ₹10-50.

name: Birsa Munda Swarojgar Yojana
description: Self-employment scheme exclusively for ST youth. Subsidy + loan for starting micro-enterprises.

benefits.description: Loan up to ₹5 lakh with 50% subsidy (max ₹2.5 lakh) for ST youth to start businesses.

offline_steps: Apply at ITDA (Integrated Tribal Development Agency) office

name: Jharkhand Universal Health Insurance
description: State health insurance scheme supplementing Ayushman Bharat for families not covered under PMJAY.

benefits.description: ₹5 lakh cashless health cover per family per year at empanelled hospitals in Jharkhand.

offline_steps: Register at nearest Primary Health Centre

name: Mukhyamantri Shramik (Labour Welfare)
description: Welfare package for registered construction/unorganized workers — education aid, medical, maternity, funeral benefits.

benefits.description: Education aid ₹8,000-25,000/child; Medical ₹5,000-1L; Maternity ₹30,000; Funeral ₹10,000; Tool kit ₹5,000.

offline_steps: Register as worker at District Labour Office
Apply for benefits at Labour Welfare Board

name: CM Research Fellowship
description: Research fellowship of ₹25,000/month for PhD scholars from Jharkhand pursuing research in state universities.

benefits.description: ₹25,000/month (₹3 lakh/year) for up to 3 years. Must be enrolled in PhD in a Jharkhand university.

name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS)
description: Central pension for BPL elderly: ₹200/month (60-79 years), ₹500/month (80+ years). Jharkhand tops up via Sarvajan.

benefits.description: ₹200/month (60-79 yrs); ₹500/month (80+ yrs). State adds top-up.

name: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension (IGNDPS)
description: Central pension for BPL persons with severe disability (80%+): ₹300/month (18-79), ₹500/month (80+).

benefits.description: ₹300/month (18-79 yrs, 80%+ disability); ₹500/month (80+ yrs).

name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension (IGNWPS)
description: Central pension for BPL widows aged 40-79: ₹300/month. 80+ years: ₹500/month.

benefits.description: ₹300/month (40-79 yrs); ₹500/month (80+ yrs) for BPL widows.

name: Mukhyamantri Sukanya Yojana
description: ₹20,000 one-time incentive for unmarried girls reaching 18 years to promote education and prevent child marriage.

benefits.description: ₹20,000 lump sum at age 18 for unmarried girls from BPL/SECC families.

name: Dial 112 Emergency Service
description: Single emergency number for Police, Fire, and Ambulance services across Jharkhand. Free 24/7.

benefits.description: 24/7 unified emergency response: Police, Fire Brigade, Ambulance. Average response time: 15 minutes.

name: PM Awas Yojana Urban 2.0 (PMAY-U 2.0)
department: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs, GoI
description: Extended urban housing with interest subsidy for EWS/LIG. Targets 1 crore new urban houses by 2028.

benefits.description: Central assistance up to ₹2.5 lakh for EWS; interest subsidy on home loans for LIG/MIG.

offline_steps: Apply online or at municipal office

name: Aapki Yojana Aapki Sarkar (AYAS)
description: Door-to-door governance camps bringing all government services directly to villages. Certificate issuance on spot.

benefits.description: One-stop camp for Aadhaar enrollment, ration card, pension, caste/income certificates — all at village level.

offline_steps: Attend AYAS camp in your panchayat

name: JOHAR (Jharkhand Opportunities for Harnessing Rural Growth)
department: Dept of Rural Development, Jharkhand (World Bank aided)
description: Livelihood enhancement project for SHG women, farmers, and rural entrepreneurs through skill training and market linkage.

benefits.description: SHG grants, farmer producer organization support, skill training, and market access. ₹50,000 per SHG.

name: Jharkhand Skill Improvement Programme
description: Short-term skill training (2-6 months) in ITI trades for Jharkhand youth, integrated with placement support.

benefits.description: Free training in 40+ trades (electrician, plumber, welder, etc.) + stipend + placement assistance.

offline_steps: Register at nearest ITI or skill centre

name: PM KUSUM (Solar for Farmers)
name_hindi: पीएम कुसुम (किसानों के लिए सौर ऊर्जा)
department: Ministry of New & Renewable Energy, GoI
description: Solar pump and grid-connected solar plant subsidies for farmers to replace diesel pumps and earn from solar energy.

benefits.description: 60% subsidy on solar pumps (2-10 HP). Farmers can sell surplus solar power to grid and earn.

name: Jharkhand Krishi Yantra Subsidy
description: Subsidy up to 80% on farm machinery (tractor, power tiller, thresher) for small/marginal farmers.

benefits.description: 50-80% subsidy on farm machinery. SC/ST: 80%; General: 50%. Max ₹5 lakh subsidy.

offline_steps: Select machinery from approved dealer list

name: Jharkhand Matsya Vikas Yojana (Fisheries)
description: Subsidies for fish farming — pond construction, fish seed, feed, and equipment for rural fish farmers.

benefits.description: 40-60% subsidy on pond construction, fish seed, aerators. SC/ST get higher subsidy.

name: PM Kisan Maandhan Yojana
description: Voluntary pension for small/marginal farmers: ₹3,000/month after 60. Equal contribution by government.

benefits.description: ₹3,000/month pension after 60. Contribution: ₹55-200/month (age-based). Govt matches 50%.

name: Birsa Seva Vahini (Free Ambulance)
description: Free emergency ambulance service covering all blocks. Dial 102 for pregnancy/child transport, 108 for emergencies.

benefits.description: Free 24/7 ambulance. 102: maternal/child transport. 108: emergency. GPS tracked. Avg response: 20 min.

name: Sahiya (ASHA) Incentive Scheme
description: Monthly honorarium + performance incentives for Sahiya (ASHA) workers providing maternal/child healthcare at village level.

benefits.description: ₹3,000/month honourarium + per-case incentives (ANC, delivery, immunization). Total ~₹5,000+/month.

name: Nikshay Poshan Yojana (TB Patients)
description: ₹500/month nutrition support for all TB patients during treatment to improve recovery.

benefits.description: ₹500/month via DBT during entire TB treatment (6-24 months). Also covers MDR-TB patients.

documents_required.name: Nikshay Registration ID from DOTS centre

offline_steps: Register at nearest DOTS (TB treatment) centre

name: Rashtriya Swasthya Bima Yojana (RSBY)
description: Health insurance for BPL families & unorganized workers: ₹30,000/year coverage for hospitalisation.

benefits.description: ₹30,000/year family hospitalisation cover. Smart card based. Pre-existing diseases covered from day 1.

name: Mukhyamantri Jan Aushadhi Yojana (Free Medicine)
description: Free essential medicines at government hospitals and Jan Aushadhi centres across Jharkhand.

benefits.description: 800+ free generic medicines at government hospitals. Jan Aushadhi stores sell at 50-90% discount.

name: State Minority Scholarship
description: Scholarship for meritorious minority students in Class 1-10 to support education expenses.

benefits.description: ₹1,000-₹10,000/year based on class level. Covers books, uniform, and tuition fees.

name: SC/ST Free Hostel Scheme
description: Free hostel accommodation with meals for SC/ST students studying in government schools and colleges.

benefits.description: Free hostel stay + 3 meals/day. Available at district-level Eklavya/Kasturba hostels.

name: Free Bicycle for Students
description: Free bicycle to Class 9 students of government schools to reduce dropouts and improve attendance.

benefits.description: Free bicycle (worth ~₹3,500) to all Class 9 students in government/government-aided schools.

name: Free Uniform & Books Scheme
description: Free school uniforms (2 sets) and textbooks for all students in government schools (Class 1-8).

benefits.description: 2 sets of uniforms + all NCERT/state textbooks free. Distributed at school level.

name: Jharkhand Smart Ration Card (AePDS)
department: Dept of Food & Public Distribution, Jharkhand
description: Aadhaar-enabled smart ration card system for portable PDS. Collect ration from any FPS in the state.

benefits.description: Aadhaar-authenticated ration collection from ANY fair price shop using biometrics. Portability across districts.

offline_steps: Link Aadhaar with ration card online
Or at nearest CSC/Block Supply Office

name: PM SHRI Schools Scheme
description: Upgradation of 14,500 schools into PM SHRI model schools with modern infrastructure, labs, and NEP 2020 pedagogy.

benefits.description: Smart classrooms, science/computer labs, library, sports facilities at upgraded government schools. Free admission.

offline_steps: Selected government schools upgraded as PM SHRI

name: Annapurna Yojana
description: 10 kg free food grains/month to eligible senior citizens (65+) who are not getting pension from any source.

benefits.description: 10 kg food grains (rice/wheat) free per month to destitute elderly not receiving any pension.

offline_steps: Must not be receiving any pension

name: Mukhyamantri Jan Samvad (Grievance Portal)
description: Online public grievance portal for Jharkhand citizens to register complaints and track resolution.

benefits.description: File complaints online. Track status. Resolution within 30 days. Covers all departments.

name: Mukhyamantri Laghu Udyami Yojana
description: ₹2 lakh grant to 25 lakh families for starting micro-businesses. Linked with SECC data for BPL families.

benefits.description: ₹2 lakh grant (not loan) per family for starting any micro-enterprise. No repayment needed.

name: Jharkhand Niji Nalkup Sinchai Yojana
description: Subsidy for boring private tube wells for irrigation. 60-80% subsidy based on category.

benefits.description: 60% subsidy (General), 80% (SC/ST) for boring tube wells up to 70m depth. Max ₹1 lakh.

offline_steps: Geo-tagging of bore well location required

name: Jharkhand Krishi Input Anudan
description: Input subsidy for disaster-affected farmers — seeds, fertilizers, pesticides after crop loss for recovery.

benefits.description: ₹6,800/hectare (rain-fed), ₹13,500/hectare (irrigated), ₹18,000/hectare (perennial crops).

offline_steps: Apply online on DBT Agriculture portal

name: Swachh Bharat Mission (SBM) - Toilet
description: ₹12,000 incentive for constructing individual household toilets to achieve Open Defecation Free (ODF) status.

benefits.description: ₹12,000 (₹12K central + MNREGA convergence) for constructing twin-pit/septic tank toilet.

name: Jal Jeevan Mission (Har Ghar Jal)
description: Piped tap water connection to every rural household. Functional Household Tap Connection (FHTC) at no cost.

benefits.description: Free piped tap water connection supplying 55 litres/person/day. Quality monitoring through WQMS.

offline_steps: Contact Gram Panchayat or Jal Sahiya

name: Anganwadi Worker/Helper Honorarium
department: Dept of Women & Child Development, Jharkhand
description: Monthly honorarium for Anganwadi Workers (₹10,000/month) and Helpers (₹5,500/month) providing ICDS services.

benefits.description: AWW: ₹10,000/month; AWH: ₹5,500/month. Performance incentives up to ₹1,000/month extra.

offline_steps: Apply through CDPO (Child Development Project Officer)

name: Free Bicycle for Girls (Class 8)
description: Free bicycle specifically for girls in Class 8 in government schools to improve retention and reduce dropout.

benefits.description: Free bicycle (~₹3,500) for all girls enrolled in Class 8 at government/aided schools.

name: Free Seed Distribution (Kharif/Rabi)
description: Free or subsidized high-yield variety seeds (rice, wheat, pulses, oilseeds) for Kharif and Rabi seasons.

benefits.description: Free/subsidized certified seeds: 10-20 kg rice, 20 kg wheat, 5 kg dal seeds per farmer per season.

offline_steps: Collect from Block Agriculture Office before sowing

name: Eklavya Model Residential School (EMRS)
description: CBSE-affiliated residential schools for ST students in tribal areas with free education, boarding, and meals.

benefits.description: Free education (Class 6-12) + hostel + meals + uniforms + books. CBSE curriculum. Sports and labs.

offline_steps: Apply at school directly or district tribal welfare office

name: Kasturba Gandhi Balika Vidyalaya (KGBV)
description: Free residential schools for girls from SC/ST/OBC/Minority in educationally backward blocks (Class 6-12).

benefits.description: Free education (Class 6-12) + hostel + meals + uniforms for girls. Focus on educationally backward areas.

offline_steps: Apply through school or district education office
Preference to out-of-school girls and dropouts

name: CM Smart School Yojana
description: Converting 4,000 government schools into smart schools with digital boards, tablets, and internet connectivity.

benefits.description: Digital smart boards, tablets for students, free Wi-Fi. Covers Class 1-12 at upgraded schools.

name: Van Dhan Vikas Kendra
department: TRIFED / Ministry of Tribal Affairs, GoI
description: Value addition centres for tribal people to process and sell forest produce (lac, mahua, honey, herbs) at fair prices.

benefits.description: Training in value-addition + ₹15,000 working capital per SHG. Market linkage through Tribes India/GEM.

offline_steps: Join Van Dhan SHG through JSLPS

name: CM Migrant Worker Return Scheme
description: Skill mapping, job placement, and self-employment support for returned migrant workers from Jharkhand.

benefits.description: Skill training + ₹25,000 self-employment grant + job placement assistance for returned migrants.

offline_steps: Attend skill mapping camp at Block level

name: PM Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan
description: Employment in 25 infrastructure works for returned migrant workers in rural areas — convergence of 12 schemes.

benefits.description: ₹257/day (Jharkhand rate) in construction of rural roads, housing, water bodies, fibre cable laying.

name: Jharkhand Disability Scholarship
description: Scholarship for students with 40%+ disability studying in Class 1-12 and higher education in Jharkhand.

benefits.description: ₹5,000-₹15,000/year based on disability level and class. Covers tuition+books+aids.

offline_steps: Apply online or at District Welfare Office

name: Kisan Call Centre & Krishi Clinic
name_hindi: किसान कॉल सेंटर और कृषि क्लिनिक
description: Toll-free helpline 1800-180-1551 for farmers — crop advice, pest management, weather alerts, market prices.

benefits.description: 24/7 toll-free helpline. Expert advice in Hindi. SMS weather alerts. Market price info via mKisan portal.

name: CM Drought Relief 2.0 (Enhanced)
description: Enhanced drought relief with increased compensation — ₹5,000/family plus input subsidy for next season recovery.

benefits.description: ₹5,000 immediate relief + free seeds/fertilizer for next season. Covers all drought-declared blocks.
